responsibility: Defines the Epiphany target’s compile-time configuration macros, ABI constants, register names/numbers, storage layout rules, assembler syntax hooks, mode-switching entities, and driver specs. It sets predefined macros, library/startfile specs, endianness and alignment policies, register and case-vector conventions, function/stack properties, asm emission macros, and declarations for the backend’s custom RTL passes, making it the main target description header that parameterizes generic GCC code for the Epiphany architecture.
same_name_distinction: This is the target configuration header for the Epiphany port: it provides preprocessor macros, ABI constants, register/layout definitions, assembler-output macros, and declarations consumed by the backend, instead of implementing hooks in epiphany.cc, encoding RTL insn patterns in epiphany.md, or listing command-line options in epiphany.opt.
